author: ViolentBoo
body:
So this is a map that I made and I think that would be pretty fun in my opinion. Not much to say about it, it is the first four team DTM map that could be accepted. Just tell me what you think <3

Somethings to note about:
Everything is soulbound except blocks, things that are crafted, and gapples.
Every 10 seconds or so, someone random on the map will get an apple :D

Images: http://imgur.com/8fLUXYj,kp61i59,1Qb2Ycv,Zm1htnW,GPLnSEx,tW5IZfU,xLuYv5D,HvJuukb,PouG1EG,hGsj4w9,TG9...

Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?4jr884fx68azsb7

Thanks guys!
